results_known_at_this_freeze.D22/D22b: out of fold the raw ensemble improves when h and c are added; the public score falls

why: With the sub-frame inputs the members that work on the public test are the bank families hx and hc. The one way to enlarge the ensemble that does not add a family the public score has rejected is more members of the same two families. Expected size from the member-diversity diagnostic B3 (error correlation .59-.84; the removable part of the ensemble error scales as 1/N): about 1 % of each term's error from 32 to 67 members, i.e. of the order of +1e-5 to +3e-5 in d3d_S, mostly through Consistency. Small; stated before the fits.
v29_second_seed_set: the 35 hx/hc members of protocol_alldata_refit_20260929 (recipe 30-64) fitted again exactly as in v29 (same extended all-data tables, settings, calibration flags, code) with seed + 5000 (hx 5090-5100, hc 5200-5223); names <member>_all_s2. Kaggle CPU kernels s2a-s2e (six members each, 30-59) and the ML350 CPU for 60-64 (--allow-host as for v29 members 0-32). Readout bank refitted as for v29.
failed_fits: calibration flux R2 < 0.999 -> the member is dropped; no retry (these are additional members, the recipe is already complete without them).
candidate: H3 = all hx/hc members with sub-frame inputs that pass: H0's 32 + v29 hx 30-32 (already fitted and in H1a) + the second-seed set; deployed finisher; with the tree blend at the G1 weights if H0t has passed its rule (amendment 4), without it otherwise. One build, one Development submission with MAST v11.
rule: Deploy H3 if its public d3d_S exceeds the then-deployed score by at least 1e-5; otherwise the display stays.
disclosure: The restriction to hx/hc is a choice made on public scores (H0, H1a, H1); the second-seed members themselves are not selected on any score.
exposure: no second-seed network exists at this freeze; H0t not scored.
